m: पुथ् cl. 4. P. पुथ्यति, to hurt, Dhātup. xxvi, 12 : Caus. पोथयति (Ā. p. पोथयान, fut. पोथयिष्ये), to crush, kill, destroy, MBh.; Hariv.; to overpower or drown (one sound by another), Kathās.; to speak or to shine (भाषार्थे, or भासार्थे), Dhātup. xxxiii, 102.
a: पुथ् — {vI.v} {c4c} P. (पुथ्यति) To injure, hurt. --Caus. 1 To destroy completely, annihilate. --2 To overpower, drown (as a sound). --3 To speak. --4 To shine. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (पोथयति-ते) To shine.

s: i kunTe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) paYcamasvarI । i, punTyate । antaHsTapraTamAdirayamityanye । punTati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ka tvizi । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curA॰para॰-aka॰-sew .) ka, poTayati । tvizi dIptO । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ya hiMse । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) ya, puTyati pupoTa । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: hiMse di॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । puTyati apoTIt । pupoTa ।
vaDe saka॰ kleSe aka॰ BvA॰ para॰ sew idit । punTati a punTIt pupunTa punTyate ।
dIptO cu॰ uma॰ saka॰ sew । poTayati te apUpuTat--ta ।
